findings.title: Remove the committed API key and fail closed.
findings.rationale: This fallback exposes a reusable credential in the source and silently masks a missing SERVICE_API_KEY. A deployment can therefore send requests under a shared identity. The comment says staging, but the value uses the sk-live- prefix. Revoke and rotate it if it is real. Remove the literal and return an explicit configuration error, or ensure every caller rejects an empty key. Do not commit a replacement key.
